test_title: RRB Technician Grade III Official Paper (Held On: 23 Dec, 2024 Shift 1)
subject: general
question: 'Project Udbhav is an initiative aimed at rediscovering and integrating ancient Indian military knowledge from texts on statecraft, warfare, diplomacy and grand strategy into modern military practices.' Who launched Project Udbhav?

options.text: Army Training Command (ARTRAC) and Indian Air Force
Indian Army and United Service Institution (USI)
Indian Navy and Defence Research and Development Organisation (DRDO)
Ministry of Defence and National Defence Academy (NDA)

solution:
The correct answer is __**Indian Army and United Service Institution (USI)**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Project Udbhav** is an initiative to rediscover and integrate **ancient Indian military knowledge** into modern military practices.
 
• It focuses on texts related to **statecraft, warfare, diplomacy, and grand strategy**.
 
• The project aims to enhance the effectiveness and richness of **contemporary military doctrines** by drawing from **historical Indian knowledge**.
 
• The **Indian Army** and the **United Service Institution (USI)** are the key organizations driving this initiative.
 
• The **United Service Institution (USI)** is a prestigious institution that conducts research and training in **defence and security studies**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

__
 
• **Army Training Command (ARTRAC) and Indian Air Force**__

 __
 
• The **Army Training Command (ARTRAC)** is responsible for institutional training in the **Indian Army**.
 
• The **Indian Air Force** is the air arm of the **Indian Armed Forces**.
 
 
 
• **Indian Navy and Defence Research and Development Organisation (DRDO)**__
 __
 
• The **Indian Navy** is the naval branch of the **Indian Armed Forces**.
 
• The **Defence Research and Development Organisation (DRDO)** is responsible for the development of technology for use by the **military**.
 
 
 
• **Ministry of Defence and National Defence Academy (NDA)**__
 
 
• The **Ministry of Defence** is charged with coordinating and supervising all agencies and functions of the government relating directly to **national security and the armed forces**.
 
• The **National Defence Academy (NDA)** is the joint services academy of the **Indian Armed Forces**, where cadets of the three services, the Army, the Navy, and the Air Force train together before they go on to respective service academies for further pre-commission training.
